name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessible bathroom remodel in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessible bathroom remodel in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, look for experience specifically in accessible or universal design bathroom remodels. Verify their licensing, insurance, and ask for references from previous accessible projects. Review their portfolio to assess their quality of work and design capabilities. A good contractor will also understand local building codes in areas like Pacifica or Daly City and offer clear communication and transparent pricing. City Dweller, LLC specializes in these types of renovations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with specific experience in accessible design, verified licensing, good references, and knowledge of local Bay Area building codes.
